measurement_scope.working_tree_note: The harness status field lists only in-progress issue_829 measurement artifacts; source commits, binary identities, corpus manifests, prune manifests, and repository pins are independently hash-bound.

release_to_head.interpretation: The head is faster in aggregate than the official v0.18.0 binary while reporting 464 additional families; neither same-binary control approaches the 5% gate. No release-relative runtime regression is present.

stabilization_behavior_preservation.interpretation: The only full-file binary differences are Mach-O LC_UUID and the derived ad-hoc code signature; executable code identity and all product outputs are unchanged.

microbenchmark_diagnostic.policy: diagnostic-only; product alternating runs and controls are authoritative

test_diagnostic.interpretation: Build and link work, not test bodies, dominates the workspace command; no tests were weakened or merged for timing.

quality_changes.result: One Rust map-default evidence fixture now owns shared IL/evidence setup while three tests retain separate observable assertions.
Query-regression and runtime-triage provenance now retain full artifact SHA-256 and add a normalized Mach-O code SHA-256 that excludes LC_UUID and ad-hoc signature bytes.
The substantial default-surface budget tightened from 30 to 29 with no new family.
Runtime triage now requires the official release asset for post-release baselines and marks Criterion cached change percentages as diagnostic only.

rejected_changes: Do not share code-detector and Markdown Union-Find implementations through a new utility crate; the engines have different policies and the dependency would worsen architecture.
Do not split files mechanically at the 599-line ratchet; the current gate passes and no behavior boundary justified a move.
Do not optimize tests from the 84.41-second workspace wall time; measured test bodies take about 10.42 seconds and build/link work owns the remainder.
Do not patch product runtime: the official release comparison is faster, the stabilization code is code-identical, and the apparent stage regression came from Mach-O identity and control noise.

next_action.reason: The stabilization pass has unchanged product behavior, a tighter quality ratchet, a release-based runtime baseline, and no unresolved performance regression.

validation_commands: jq -n -e --slurpfile closeout bench/recall_loss/issue_829_stabilization_closeout.v1.json --slurpfile release bench/recall_loss/issue_829_release_vs_head_2026_07_12.v1.json --slurpfile release_control bench/recall_loss/issue_829_release_control_2026_07_12.v1.json --slurpfile head_control bench/recall_loss/issue_829_head_control_2026_07_12.v1.json --slurpfile preservation bench/recall_loss/issue_829_main_before_vs_head_2026_07_12.v1.json '($closeout[0].release_to_head.aggregate_delta_pct == $release[0].summary.aggregate_delta_pct) and ($closeout[0].release_to_head.release_control_delta_pct == $release_control[0].summary.aggregate_delta_pct) and ($closeout[0].release_to_head.head_control_delta_pct == $head_control[0].summary.aggregate_delta_pct) and ($closeout[0].stabilization_behavior_preservation.aggregate_delta_pct == $preservation[0].summary.aggregate_delta_pct) and ($preservation[0].provenance.baseline_binary_code_sha256 == $preservation[0].provenance.current_binary_code_sha256) and ([ $preservation[0].summary.hashes_identical_by_repo[] ] | all)'
